decision_rule.ADMITTED: on the anchor base AND on the cell B1 base: (1) the CI95 lower bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta is > 0; (2) the paired intent delta is non-inferior at -h_intent, i.e. its CI95 lower bound exceeds -1.0051; (3) no scenario's paired intent CI95 upper bound lies below zero; and (4) owner decision 17's net-harmed-rows-per-scenario diagnostic is reported
decision_rule.HARMFUL: owner decision 25's Method B form -- only by a MEASURED LOSS: a point estimate of official pooled SLU or of intent below -h (-1.1218 / -1.0051), or a CI95 upper bound below zero, on either gating base
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: otherwise; an interval that straddles zero with the point estimate inside the margin reads NEUTRAL with 'non-inferiority not proven' stated
decision_rule.not_a_bar_attempt: cell B8a is a one-factor module admission. The verdict states the official pooled SLU each base reaches with the node and whether any of them clears 64.00, as a fact and not as a claim; 'replicated on the same roster' (owner decision 1) is not claimed.
decision_rule.stop_condition: Before any table is read: (1) the three sealed comparators reproduce their registered OFFICIAL aggregates -- 48.53/77.96, 61.14/80.19, 62.34/80.09 -- to the hundredth of a point; (2) the node-ON side of each arm reproduces that arm's registered PROJECTION V3 aggregates -- 51.99/79.35, 62.67/81.76, 63.78/81.85 -- to the hundredth, which the triple-equality property predicts exactly; (3) every row is accounted for, 1,080 in and 1,080 out, per arm. If any clause fails, the read STOPS and is reported.
decision_rule.symmetric_is_not_a_gate: owner decision 7 states that about 2.5 pp of the 64-point bar is representation alignment rather than capability; owner decisions 23 and 26 make the OFFICIAL number the metric and this node the legitimate carrier of that alignment. The TRAIN symmetric number is REPORTED beside and gates nothing for this module.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, role-graph, prompt, geometry or cap change, and no silent recovery. At most one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes cell B8a and the fix must be proven on a four-row dry run before the node is proposed again. A partial manifest is never scored and never read. One experiment in flight at a time. Resume-recovery clause (owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18): an INFRASTRUCTURE death with code and request bytes unchanged may be recovered as a resume-recovery under item E10 instead of a re-fly, keeping every complete row without selection, re-flying every partial or unstarted row under the same run id, declaring the predecessor attempt with its trace hash and kept-row list in the merged manifest, changing no question, roster, factor, comparator, decision rule or cap, and re-checking the run-cumulative budget.

idempotence.anchor: 1079 / 1080. On ONE row a date filler is not a fixed point of P2: the first application removes punctuation and converts one numeric token to words, which changes the token boundaries so a second application converts a remaining digit as well; the third application is a fixed point. I7n requires DETERMINISM, not idempotence, and the read is unaffected because the scorer applies P2 exactly once and so does the node. Recorded as an engineering finding: rails/delivery_normalisers.py's unqualified 'idempotent by construction' is proved on cell B1's rows and is not a general property.

purpose: Decide module M3 -- the SLURP USE projection v3 executed INSIDE the agent as a deterministic, zero-contact delivery node -- with (a) a four-row smoke proving the node executed in the agent and changed nothing else, and (b) a MODEL-FREE admission read over three sealed arms, because a deterministic zero-contact node's ON arm is computable from any sealed OFF arm's own bytes.
quality_gate: The four-row smoke is STRUCTURAL ONLY and is never scored: contact counts, the native_episode_receipt.deliver_normaliser block on 4 of 4 rows, request-fit receipts, the offline replay reproducing the delivered bytes on 4 of 4 rows, invariant I7n at the seal, and a clean seal -- with no answer, reference or quality interpretation. Cell B8a's task-quality read is MODEL-FREE and is not this run's: it re-applies the registered rule to read-only copies of three sealed arms (the dual-store anchor recovery, cell B1's recovery arm and cell B5e's recovery arm), scores OFF and ON with the pinned official scorer, and may not be read before its STOP condition passes -- the three OFF arms reproducing 48.53/77.96, 61.14/80.19 and 62.34/80.09 and the three ON arms reproducing 51.99/79.35, 62.67/81.76 and 63.78/81.85, each to the hundredth of a point. No comparator is ever re-flown or re-scored from the sealed directory.

resampling.pairing_note: the ON and OFF arms are the SAME sealed rows one deterministic transform apart, so the paired bootstrap carries no decoding noise at all -- only the row-to-row variation of the rule's own effect. The own-null margins were calibrated on a request-identical replicate whose two passes DO differ by decoding noise, so they are conservative here, and the verdict says so rather than treating a narrow interval as extra evidence.

smoke_acceptance.expected_but_not_required: on the sealed B1 arm's own bytes the rule repairs NOTHING on all four of these rows (applied true, changed false, rendering_suppressed true, 4 of 4). Greedy decoding at temperature 0 is not bitwise reproducible across batch compositions, so a repair may occur; acceptance does not require one. The repair path is proved by the 1,080-row sealed replay on three arms and by the E11 unit tests.
